notes: needs_ruling (rule 11, narrated encounter): the saying is Abdullah ibn Masud's ruling inside a story where Abu Musa, Salman and Abdullah speak; not settled whether Abdullah is the last link or only in the scene, so the chain stops at هزيل
«وقد رواه شعبة عن أبي قيس» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن» and «اسمه عبد الرحمن بن ثروان» are compiler remarks, left out
